pricing.notes: Remote sells several products: Payroll at $29 per employee per month, Contractor Management at $29 per contractor, Contractor Management Plus at $99, and Employer of Record at $699 per employee. The "HR Management" tier upstream recorded at $10 does not appear as such; the page shows an HR product "from $39 per month", so the plan mapping is not fully certain.
